description: The primitive curvature-gap constants of the MUB(6) cover, chaining, gluing and synthesis modules. The crate derives the critical step, the erosion, the margin and the circulation floor from these; it computes none of these four.

base_gap.reason: Gap floor epsilon = (81/100 - 1/6)^2. Its derivation assumes the candidate fourth basis has col 0 real part in [9/10, 1]; no cover computes it, and every cover that reads it certifies boxes from it.

lipschitz_bound.reason: Uniform Lipschitz bound L of the curvature gap. No derivation or check in the crate.

delta_certified.reason: Mesh step and excision radius delta. Chosen, not derived; the only check is delta < epsilon / L.

total_domain_volume.reason: Six-chart domain volume 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1/1000 + 1, written as a sum of declared chart volumes rather than measured from the charts.
